where.if: AND (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_info (video_id, user_id, title, description, cover_url, video_url, duration, category, tags, view_count, like_count, comment_count, favorite_count, heat, status, create_time) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{videoUrl}, #{duration}, #{category}, #{tags}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE video_info SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
UPDATE video_info SET status = #{status} WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM video_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 2
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(like_count), 0) FROM video_info WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 2
SELECT * FROM video_info WHERE status = 2 ORDER BY heat DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT v.* FROM video_info v JOIN user_follow uf ON v.user_id = uf.follow_user_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND v.status = 2 ORDER BY v.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM video_info v JOIN user_follow uf ON v.user_id = uf.follow_user_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} AND v.status = 2
mapper.update: UPDATE video_info SET heat = #{heat} WHERE video_id = #{videoId}
UPDATE video_info SET heat = view_count * 1 + like_count * 5 + comment_count * 10 + favorite_count * 8 WHERE status = 2
